title: Implement bounded Lean procedure routing and offline evaluation reliability
scope: Implement WI-0225 first slice: opt-in operation-scoped Lean instructions with whole-source fallback; offline command diagnostics and typed evaluation stop handling. Preserve distinct Verifier, old protocols and sealed samples. No live generation, default change, merge, release or publication.
acceptance_criteria: Build/Test route complete current-operation instructions; unknown or independently required sources retain whole-source material. Real CLI and parser replay agree; typed stops preserve failed samples and halt on shared uncertainty. Full local verification, init smoke and separate candidate review required.
overlap_resolution: WI-0172: no active claim; WI-0226 owns the new implementation. Prior protocols, historical artifacts and sealed labs are unchanged; source changes are successor-only.
